text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Rounding the fourth corner into the final stretch!!
A gathering of shining dreams!! Who will take the victory!?

text_block_list.name: The Shining Ones
text_block_list.text: ââHAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHH!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha!
――Alright, here we gooo!!!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ――OOOAAAAAAAHHH!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Stay Gold!
Stay Gold closes in on the goal!
Stay Gold, Stay Gold!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Stay Gollllddd!!!!
Crossing the finish line in first!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Claiming victory in the dream race is Stay Gold!!
The golden brilliance was right here all along!!!!
(WOOOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOO!! That was the best race ever!!
The greatest run ever!! Stay Gold is the strongest!!
I'm so seriously moveddddd!!!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Oh man... I'm totally tearing up...!!
There'll never be another race like this, ever...!!
Stay Gold, congratulations...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ......I have indeed received it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations.
Stay Gold-san—
—She was simply too dazzling to behold.
"Shining brighter than any other being present, a figure no one could help but love—truly—"

...Looking around, I understand.
What her brilliance has brought about.
Just how grand, how precious it is—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: …………Big Sis……――

(SteGo!! SteGo!! SteGo!!
SteGo!! SteGo!! SteGo!!)

(—Stego!! Stego!! Stego!!
Stego!! Stego!! Stego!!)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Haha...!
Incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: (...Everything in the world was shining—)

"—300 meters remaining!
Yet the leader is five lengths ahead!!
Come on, Stay, hang in there!"

"Stay Gold!
Stay Gold comes chasing from behind!
Stay Gold! Surge ahead and take it!!"
"Stay Gold! Stay Gold! Stay Gold! STAY GOOOOOLD! She's surged past the rest and takes the winーーー!!!"
(WOOOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

"CONGRATS ON YOUR G1 VICTORYYYYY!!!
STAY GOOOOLD!!!"

"THANK YOU FOR MOVING OUR HEARTS SO DEEPLY!!!
YOU REALLY, REALLY GAVE IT YOUR ALL!!!"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: They're overlapping...?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
(The edge of "memory" and this scenery...
intertwine every time the wind blows...—)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: (Where I ended up would be a different radiance... or so I thought—)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ――...Ah, I see.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: (...Deep down, we're the same――)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: (The countless feelings here right now... The words being bestowed... are filled with the same blessings as "back then"—)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: (Even if the journeys differ... Even if the races are not the same... The root of this warmth remains unchanged—)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...An immutable, golden shine.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
(And that is why I realized.
What my very own "new gold" truly is—)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...I have my answer.

――Stego-san!!
――Stego-senpai!!
――Stego!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: (...Thank you, my inspiration.)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: (...Thank you, my beloved friend.)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: (...Thank you, everlasting radiances...)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ――...Shall we get going now?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Here I go.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...I've got a partner waiting for me at the Winner's Circle, you see.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ......See ya, Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
...Until we meet again someday—
(WOOOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Yo.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ――...Fufu, haha...――

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
—Hahahahahaha!!
We did it, hey!! We won!!
choice_data_list: Yeah, we won!! In the best race ever!!
Yeah, we won!! In the best race ever!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
In an Arima Kinen shining so brightly...!!
We will...!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
――...Hey, Trainer.
The "new gold" was definitely real.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Thanks.
Because of you—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: It was truly the most fascinating journey.
...In that instant, I understood everything.

Stay Gold had, today...
reached a certain culmination—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Before long, I'll be setting out on a long journey.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Because I was able to find what I was looking for.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Next, I've got to go tell them
all about my travels with you.

"...Not 'to whom'. Nor 'where to'.
Not 'until when'. Nor 'why'."

And "I want to follow them," too.
...Endless emotions welled up inside me.
However————
From the journey I've shared with her so far, and through all the time we've built up together, I just know.

"That 'long journey' is surely
one that only she can undertake."
choice_data_list: Shall we take it easy until then?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed.
I think I will take my time preparing
while looking back on how far we've come."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
............At the end of a long journey,
our paths will definitely cross again someday.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: In that case, maybe I'll set out on a new journey.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I don't know when it'll be, but...
look forward to it, alright?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: I'll look forward to it too, then.

Far away.
Making a promise bound for the distant future...—

The final days began, leading up to
her departure on the next journey—
